note: 7단계 레이아웃 선택용 카탈로그. 레퍼런스 팩의 템플릿 카탈로그 방식처럼 use_when / avoid_when / required_inputs를 명시한다. Appends 40 legacy-pack templates with field_shapes from PHASE1A_field_contract.

templates.name: 시네마틱 표지
use_when: 제안 주제와 컨셉을 첫 장에서 강하게 각인해야 할 때
실제 현장/제품/상징 이미지가 있을 때
avoid_when: 이미지 소재가 없고 텍스트만 있는 경우
templates.layout: 풀블리드 이미지 또는 어두운 배경, 좌측/하단 큰 제목, 짧은 컨셉 문장, 작은 메타

templates.name: 고민 제시 도입
use_when: 발주처의 고민을 질문 2~3개로 압축할 때
제안 전체가 이 질문의 답으로 전개될 때
avoid_when: 근거 없이 위기감을 과장해야 하는 경우
templates.layout: 큰 질문 1개 + 보조 질문 카드 2~3개 + 하단 답변 예고

templates.name: 경영진 요약
use_when: 한 장에서 판단해야 할 핵심 결론과 근거를 동시에 보여줄 때
templates.layout: 상단 결론 문장 + 3개 근거 카드 + 검토요망/리스크 표시

templates.name: 데이터 해석형
use_when: 숫자 자체보다 숫자의 의미를 말해야 할 때
차트와 해석 포인트가 함께 필요할 때
templates.layout: 좌측 차트/숫자 + 우측 해석 2~3개 + 출처

templates.name: As-Is / To-Be 대비
use_when: 현재 문제와 목표 상태를 명확히 대비할 때
전환 논리가 핵심일 때
templates.layout: 2열 대비 + 중앙 전환 화살표 + 하단 결론

templates.name: 3대 전략 체계
use_when: 실행안을 2~4개 축으로 묶을 때
선택과 집중을 보여줄 때
templates.layout: 전략 축 카드 3개 + 상위 컨셉 + 축별 대표 실행

templates.name: 기간별 실행 로드맵
use_when: 분기/월/주 단위 일정과 병렬 업무가 있을 때
templates.layout: 시간축 + 업무트랙 + 의사결정/산출물 마커

templates.name: 단계형 프로세스
use_when: 순서가 중요한 3~5단계 실행을 설명할 때
templates.layout: 번호 배지 + 단계 박스 + 단계별 산출물

templates.name: 우선순위 매트릭스
use_when: 항목을 2개 축으로 판단하고 우선순위를 정할 때
templates.layout: 2x2 또는 3단계 밴드 + 강조 항목 1~3개

templates.name: 옵션 비교표
use_when: 2~4개 선택지를 기준별로 비교할 때
templates.layout: 열=옵션, 행=기준, 추천안 강조

templates.name: 근거 이미지 보드
use_when: 사례/캡처/현장 이미지가 근거일 때
이미지 2~4개를 비교할 때
templates.layout: 같은 높이 이미지 2~4개 + 짧은 캡션 + 하단 결론 바

templates.name: 조직/역할 체계
use_when: 참여인력, 조직도, R&R을 보여줄 때
templates.layout: 상위 책임자 + 하위 역할 박스 + 보고/협업 라인

templates.name: 리스크 점검판
use_when: 리스크와 대응을 한 번에 점검할 때
avoid_when: 리스크 근거가 없거나 과장해야 하는 경우
templates.layout: 리스크 표 + 심각도 신호 + 대응책

templates.name: 실적/사례 카드
use_when: 수행 경험을 대표 사례로 설득해야 할 때
templates.layout: 대표 사례 카드 2~4개 + 성과 수치 + 검토요망 표시

templates.name: 마무리 약속 매트릭스
use_when: 제안의 차별점과 실행 약속을 마지막에 정리할 때
avoid_when: 새로운 주장을 마지막에 처음 꺼내야 하는 경우
templates.layout: 약속 3개 + 근거/실행 방식 + 컨셉 문장

templates.name: Executive Summary Paragraph
use_when: The summary is a flowing narrative of 2–4 short paragraphs and the audience expects a written argument rather than scannable bullets. Best for written reports rather than spoken decks.
avoid_when: The summary naturally breaks into 2–4 distinct takeaways with supporting bullets — use `executive_summary_takeaways` instead.
templates.layout: Renderer `executive_summary_paragraph`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Executive Summary Takeaways
use_when: The summary is structured as 2–4 bold takeaways, each backed by 2–4 bullets, optionally ending with a final recommendation. This is a common executive-summary pattern (bold takeaways + supporting bullets).
avoid_when: You only have one takeaway (use `dark_navy_summary` for a single impact statement) or have prose paragraphs (`executive_summary_paragraph`).
templates.layout: Renderer `executive_summary_takeaways`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: dark navy summary
use_when: A single impact statement deserves its own slide — typically a key finding, section divider, or 'if you remember one thing...' moment. Renders as a full-bleed deep navy slide with bold white text.
templates.layout: Renderer `dark_navy_summary`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Assessment Table
use_when: You're showing KPIs grouped by category/BU with target vs. actual values and a green/amber/red status per row. Standard for QBR or progress slides.
avoid_when: You just need a list of status items without category grouping or numeric target/actual columns — consider `three_trends_table` or `overview_areas`.
templates.layout: Renderer `assessment_table`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Bubble Chart
use_when: You want to position 5–15 entities on two continuous dimensions with bubble size encoding a third dimension. Optional diagonal reference line. Use when there is no separate takeaway pane needed.
avoid_when: You also need bullets explaining the chart (use `bubble_chart_takeaways`), or you have categorical 2x2/3x3 quadrants (use `growth_share` or `prioritization_matrix`).
required_inputs: bubbles: list[{group:str, label:str, label_pos:str, size:num, x:num, y:num}]

field_shapes.bubbles: list[{group:str, label:str, label_pos:str, size:num, x:num, y:num}]

templates.layout: Renderer `bubble_chart`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Bubble Chart Takeaways
use_when: Same scatter use case as `bubble_chart` but you also want a right-side bullet pane explaining what to read from the chart. Good for exec audiences.
avoid_when: The chart speaks for itself; or you need quadrant labels — then use `growth_share` or `prioritization_matrix`.
required_inputs: bubbles: list[{group:str, label:str, label_pos:str, size:num, x:num, y:num}]

field_shapes.bubbles: list[{group:str, label:str, label_pos:str, size:num, x:num, y:num}]

templates.layout: Renderer `bubble_chart_takeaways`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: growth-share matrix
use_when: Classic BCG portfolio analysis — market share (x) × growth rate (y) with four quadrants (Star / Question mark / Cash cow / Dog). Bubbles are business units sized by revenue/value.
avoid_when: Your axes aren't market share × growth, or you have 3x3 bands rather than a 2x2 split — use `prioritization_matrix`.
templates.layout: Renderer `growth_share`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Prioritization Matrix
use_when: Plotting initiatives on Time-to-impact (Long/Medium/Short) × Level-of-impact (Low/Medium/High), with color-coded status (green/amber/red) per item. Top-right cell is highlighted.
avoid_when: You have continuous axes — use `bubble_chart`. You have 2x2 BCG axes — use `growth_share`.
templates.layout: Renderer `prioritization_matrix`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Column Comparison
use_when: Comparing one metric across 5–12 categorical groups, sorted from high to low, with one bar highlighted in bright blue (the 'focus') and the rest in deep navy. Right-side takeaway pane.
avoid_when: Your x-axis is time — use one of the time-series column charts (`column_simple_growth`, `column_split_growth`, `column_historic_forecast`).
templates.layout: Renderer `column_comparison`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Column Simple Growth
use_when: Showing one metric across 5–10 time periods with a single overall growth-rate callout (e.g. '10% CAGR'). All bars same color.
avoid_when: Growth has a structural break mid-period (use `column_split_growth`); you need to distinguish actuals vs forecast (use `column_historic_forecast`).
templates.layout: Renderer `column_simple_growth`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Column Split Growth
use_when: A single time series has two distinct growth phases (e.g. flat then accelerating) and you want two growth-arrow annotations to highlight the inflection.
avoid_when: Growth is uniform (use `column_simple_growth`); split is forecast vs actuals (use `column_historic_forecast`).
templates.layout: Renderer `column_split_growth`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Column Historic Forecast
use_when: Showing actuals vs forecast. Historic bars in deep navy, forecast bars in bright blue, with two growth-rate arrows (historic and forecast).
avoid_when: All values are actuals — use `column_simple_growth` or `column_split_growth`.
templates.layout: Renderer `column_historic_forecast`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Three Trends Icons
use_when: Presenting exactly three trends/areas, each with a circular icon and 3–4 bullet points. Storytelling-style; less data, more narrative.
avoid_when: You have exactly five themes (use `five_key_areas`), more than three (use `overview_areas`), or want examples per theme (use `three_trends_table`).
templates.layout: Renderer `three_trends_icons`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Three Trends Table
use_when: Three trends, each with a name pill, description bullets, and example bullets in a third column.
avoid_when: You don't have concrete examples — use `three_trends_icons` or `three_trends_numbered`.
templates.layout: Renderer `three_trends_table`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Three Trends Numbered
use_when: Three trends shown as numbered rows with a bright blue label pill and bullet points. Good for sequenced/prioritized trends.
avoid_when: Not exactly three items, or icons would be more visual.
templates.layout: Renderer `three_trends_numbered`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Five Key Areas
use_when: Presenting exactly five (or six) areas, each with a name pill, a right-arrow connector, and a one-line description in alternating gray rows. Best for compact '5 strategic areas' slides.
templates.layout: Renderer `five_key_areas`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Overview Areas
use_when: 5–7 columns of 'areas' with a header pill, lettered badge (A–G), and bullet content. Optional bottom-left blue call-out tag.
avoid_when: Just five items with one-line descriptions — use `five_key_areas`. You have three items — use `three_trends_*`.
templates.layout: Renderer `overview_areas`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Issue Tree
use_when: Decomposing one root issue into hierarchical drivers (Main → Secondary → Underlying). Standard problem-solving framework slide.
templates.layout: Renderer `issue_tree`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Org Chart
use_when: Showing reporting structure: CEO → N heads → reports per head. Boxes with names/titles.
templates.layout: Renderer `org_chart`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Project Team Circles
use_when: Highlighting one leader with N teammates rendered as labeled circles (with optional Unicode icons). Best for staffing slides.
avoid_when: You need a function × role grid — use `team_chart`.
templates.layout: Renderer `project_team_circles`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Team Chart
use_when: Showing a project team broken down by function (columns) with multiple roles per function (filled or outline circles).
avoid_when: You only need a list of N teammates — use `project_team_circles`.
templates.layout: Renderer `team_chart`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Phases Chevron 3
use_when: Project breaks naturally into exactly three phases shown as chevron arrows (Discover → Design → Deliver style), each with deliverables and people lists below.
templates.layout: Renderer `phases_chevron_3`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Phases Table 4
use_when: Four phases laid out as parallel columns (Phase 1–4) with description + Key activities + Outcomes per column. More text than chevron.
templates.layout: Renderer `phases_table_4`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Waves Timeline 4
use_when: Project rolls out in four sequential waves on a single horizontal arrow (with circle markers). Each wave has a headline, key activities, and deliverables.
avoid_when: You're showing parallel workstreams over weeks (use `gantt_timeline`); only three phases (use `phases_chevron_3`).
required_inputs: waves: list[{activities:list[str], deliverables:list[str], headline:str, name:str, timeframe:str}]
templates.layout: Renderer `waves_timeline_4`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Gantt Timeline
use_when: Multiple parallel workstreams across many weeks (rows × week columns), with milestones marked at specific weeks. The right tool for detailed project plans.
templates.layout: Renderer `gantt_timeline`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Process Activities
use_when: A short project plan with 3–4 time blocks (e.g. Week 1–4, 5–8…) showing per-block Activities + Mgmt. interaction (diamond marker) + Deliverables (diamond marker).
required_inputs: steps: list[{activities:list[str], deliverable:str, interaction:str, name:str, subtitle:str}]
templates.layout: Renderer `process_activities`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Cover Slide
use_when: Every standalone deck. Renders the deck title, subtitle, client, and date with a deep navy stripe down the right edge and an optional 'CONFIDENTIAL' tag in the top-right.
avoid_when: This is an internal section divider — use `section_divider`.
templates.layout: Renderer `cover_slide`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Section Divider
use_when: Decks of more than ~10 slides need clear section breaks. Renders a left navy panel with a giant chapter number and a right title block with accent line + subtitle.
avoid_when: A single agenda slide is enough (use `agenda`).
templates.layout: Renderer `section_divider`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Agenda
use_when: Up-front roadmap of the deck (or before each major section). Numbered chapter list with optional active highlight.
avoid_when: The deck is short enough that an agenda is overhead.
templates.layout: Renderer `agenda`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Stat Hero
use_when: A single statistic is *the* point — e.g., '82% of CEOs say…', '$50B addressable market', '1.5 billion users by 2030'. Renders the number huge in deep navy with a label and optional supporting paragraph.
avoid_when: You have multiple numbers (use `kpi_dashboard`); the number is part of a chart.
templates.layout: Renderer `stat_hero`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Quote Slide
use_when: Showcasing a single interview quote, customer voice, or expert opinion. Big quotation mark + italic quote + accent line + attribution.
avoid_when: Many quotes — pick one and put the rest in an appendix.
templates.layout: Renderer `quote_slide`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Comparison Table
use_when: Comparing 2–4 options across 3–6 criteria with Harvey-ball ratings (0–4 quartile fills). Optional `recommended_index` highlights the chosen column in bright blue with a '★ Recommended' tag.
avoid_when: You have only one option (use `pros_cons`); criteria are all numeric (use a `comparison_table`-style chart in `column_comparison`).
templates.layout: Renderer `comparison_table`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.
templates.namespace_note: ID also exists in house_a catalog; prefer this house_b entry only when house_b field_shapes can be filled and the selected pack/layout target is house_b.
templates.selection_priority: pack-aware: house_b shape match beats generic id match; otherwise keep house_a/default behavior.

templates.name: Pros Cons
use_when: Two-column +/− analysis of ONE option (or as a quick check on recommendations). Green ✓ pros / red ✗ cons.
templates.layout: Renderer `pros_cons`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Two Column Compare
use_when: Before/After, As-is/To-be, Current/Future state visualization. Two cards with header bands and a connecting arrow between them.
avoid_when: You have 3+ options (use `comparison_table`); you have +/- analysis (use `pros_cons`).
templates.layout: Renderer `two_column_compare`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Stacked Column Chart
use_when: Decomposing a total into 2–5 segments per category (e.g. revenue by region across years). Per-segment values labeled inside, total labeled above each bar.
avoid_when: Showing growth of a single value (use `column_simple_growth`) or comparing two scenarios per category (use `grouped_column_chart`).
templates.layout: Renderer `stacked_column_chart`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Grouped Column Chart
use_when: Comparing 2–4 series across the same set of categories (e.g. two years per country, before/after per business unit).
templates.layout: Renderer `grouped_column_chart`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Line Chart
use_when: 1–4 lines tracking a metric over time or sequence (monthly sales, regional KPIs). Markers at every data point, configurable per-series value labels.
templates.layout: Renderer `line_chart`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Process Flow Horizontal
use_when: A 4–6 step sequential process with a one-line description per step. Numbered chevron tiles in alternating navy/bright-blue.
avoid_when: Phases need full sub-content (use `phases_chevron_3` or `phases_table_4`); process is iterative not linear.
templates.layout: Renderer `process_flow_horizontal`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: Funnel
use_when: TAM/SAM/SOM market sizing, marketing funnel (awareness → consideration → purchase → loyalty), or any quantity that shrinks down a sequence. Each band shows name + headline value; descriptions on the right.
templates.layout: Renderer `funnel`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.

templates.name: KPI dashboard
use_when: 4–8 KPIs at a glance, each with a big value, small delta (▲ green / ▼ red / ▬ flat), and optional context line. Standard for QBRs and ops reviews.
avoid_when: A single metric (use `stat_hero`); KPIs need full target/actual context (use `assessment_table`).
required_inputs: kpis: list[{context:str, delta:str, delta_dir:str, label:str, value:str}]
templates.layout: Renderer `kpi_dashboard`. Fill fields exactly as field_shapes; do not pass strings for list/object fields.
